  SELECT 
    c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    n.n_name AS nation_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue

    nation_name,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY market_segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM revenue_by_segment_nation
)

WITH asia_nation_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    n.n_name,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value
  FROM region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY n.n_name
),
average_order_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_order_value) AS avg_value
  FROM asia_nation_orders
)
SELECT

  a.total_order_value
FROM asia_nation_orders a
CROSS JOIN average_order_value avg
WHERE a.total_order_value > avg.avg_value
ORDER BY a.total_order_value DESC, a.n_name ASC
